proposals.before: Fu said: "Are there people who are as fond of beauty and as handsome as Chen Ping yet remain poor and lowly forever?"
proposals.after: Fu said: "Has there ever been a man as handsome as Chen Ping who remained poor and lowly forever?"
proposals.reason: 好美如陳平 describes Chen Ping's fine looks, not a fondness for beauty.

proposals.before: In the end he gave him his daughter.
proposals.after: In the end he gave him his granddaughter.
proposals.reason: The marriage continues 女孫 from the preceding sentences; 女 here is that granddaughter, not Zhang Fu's daughter.

proposals.before: At this time Wan Shi Jun Fen was the Han King's attendant and received Ping's visit, bringing him in to see Ping.
proposals.after: At this time Lord Wanshi Fen was the Han King's personal attendant; he received Ping's visiting card and ushered Ping in.
proposals.reason: Literal English has Ping being brought in to see Ping; 受平謁，入見平 is receiving Ping's card and Ping entering for audience.

proposals.before: The Han King said: "Young man, set it aside."
proposals.after: The Han King summoned Ping and rebuked him, saying: "Sir, you served Wei without success, then served Chu and left; now you follow me—should a trustworthy man have so many hearts?"
proposals.reason: Literal field is unrelated to 召讓平 and the rebuke about successive service to Wei, Chu, and Han.

proposals.before: As for performing merit and granting fiefs and cities, he is generous with them, but scholars also do not attach themselves for this reason.
proposals.after: As for rewarding merit with ranks and fiefs, he treats it as a weighty matter (is reluctant), and men of talent therefore do not attach themselves to him.
proposals.reason: 重之 here is stinginess/reluctance, not generosity; the literal inverts the meaning.

proposals.before: Look at Chu—there are those who can be caused to rebel. Xiang Yu's backbone ministers like Prime Minister, Zhongli Mei, Long Ju, Zhou Yin and such are only a few people.
proposals.after: Look at Chu—there are those who can be thrown into disorder. The King of Xiang's backbone ministers, men such as Yafu, Zhongli Mei, Long Ju, and Zhou Yin, number no more than a handful.
proposals.reason: 亞父 is the honorific Yafu, not Prime Minister.

proposals.before: Seeing the Chu envoys, he pretended to be astonished and said: "I thought it was the Prime Minister's envoy, but it is Xiang Yu's envoy!"
proposals.after: Seeing the Chu envoys, he pretended to be astonished and said: "I thought it was Yafu's envoy, but it is the King of Xiang's envoy!"
proposals.reason: 亞父 is the honorific Yafu, not an office glossed as Prime Minister; 項王使 is the King of Xiang's envoy, matching the idiomatic rendering.

proposals.before: Xiang Yu indeed greatly doubted the Prime Minister.
proposals.after: Xiang Yu indeed greatly doubted Yafu.
proposals.reason: 亞父 is the honorific Yafu, not a translation as Prime Minister.

proposals.before: The Prime Minister wished to urgently attack and conquer Xingyang city, but Xiang Yu did not believe him and refused to listen.
proposals.after: Yafu wished to urgently attack and conquer Xingyang city, but Xiang Yu did not believe him and refused to listen.
proposals.reason: 亞父 is the honorific Yafu, not a translation as Prime Minister.

proposals.before: The Prime Minister heard Xiang Yu doubted him, then angrily said: "The realm's affairs are greatly settled, let the king handle them himself!
proposals.after: Yafu heard Xiang Yu doubted him, then angrily said: "The realm's affairs are greatly settled, let the king handle them himself!
proposals.reason: 亞父 is the honorific Yafu, not a translation as Prime Minister.

proposals.before: Yet troops are trapped between Jing and Suo, grain exhausted under Xingyang, cannot go west beyond Xingyang, this is Chu's critical danger.
proposals.after: He had not yet reached Pengcheng on the way home when a carbuncle broke out on his back and he died.
proposals.reason: The supplied literal English is an unrelated siege sentence and does not translate 歸未至彭城，疽發背而死.

proposals.before: Chen Ping said: "Has anyone known of Xin's rebellion?"
proposals.after: Chen Ping said: "The person who submitted a letter saying Xin is rebelling—has anyone else known of it?"
proposals.reason: Literal omits that the question is whether anyone else knows of the accusation, not whether the rebellion itself is known.

proposals.before: Said: "The generals and officers who practice war, how do they compare to Chu's?"
proposals.after: Ping said: "Among Your Majesty's generals who use troops, is there anyone who can surpass Han Xin?"
proposals.reason: Literal is a different sentence and drops Han Xin; Chinese asks whether any Han general surpasses Han Xin.

proposals.before: Said: "Using troops, who can surpass Han Xin?"
proposals.after: Ping said: "Now the troops are not as elite as Chu's, and the generals cannot match him, yet to raise troops and attack him is to rush him into battle—I privately fear for Your Majesty."
proposals.reason: Literal belongs to the previous question; this unit is Ping's warning against a direct attack.

proposals.before: Chen Ping said: "Now troops do not equal Chu's excellence, generals cannot match, yet sending troops to attack him is inviting battle—privately I fear for Your Majesty.
proposals.after: Ping said: "In ancient times the Son of Heaven made inspection tours and assembled the feudal lords."
proposals.reason: Literal is the previous unit; Chinese begins the Yunmeng plan with ancient royal tours.

proposals.before: The emperor said: "What to do?
proposals.after: In the south there is Yunmeng. Your Majesty need only pretend to tour Yunmeng and assemble the feudal lords at Chen."
proposals.reason: Literal is Gaozu's question from another unit; Chinese is Ping's Yunmeng ruse.

proposals.before: Ping said: "Anciently, the Son of Heaven toured and met with the feudal lords. Mingtang was where the people gathered.
proposals.after: Chen lies on the western border of Chu. When Xin hears that the Son of Heaven is touring for pleasure, he will surely think nothing is amiss and come out to the suburbs to welcome him."
proposals.reason: Literal invents Mingtang; Chinese explains Chen as Chu's western border and predicts Xin's welcome.

proposals.before: Now Your Majesty wishes to meet the feudal lords at Chen. Now Chu King also claims to be emperor, with Your Majesty meeting Chen, there would be no place for Your Majesty."
proposals.after: When he comes to pay respects, Your Majesty can seize him—this is only the work of a single strong man."

proposals.reason: Literal is a stray question; Chinese is Gaozu adopting the plan and issuing the summons.

proposals.before: Ping said: "Anciently the Son of Heaven toured, met with feudal lords."
proposals.after: The emperor thereupon set out with them.
proposals.reason: Literal restates Ping's antiquarian remark; Chinese is Gaozu departing.

proposals.before: Southern has Yunmeng, Your Majesty falsely tours Yunmeng, meets feudal lords at Chen.
proposals.after: Before they reached Chen, King Xin of Chu indeed came out to welcome him along the road.
proposals.reason: Literal is earlier counsel; Chinese reports Han Xin meeting the emperor as predicted.

proposals.before: Chen is Chu's western border, trustworthy hears the Son of Heaven with good intentions tours, his intentions must be without affairs, will surely come out to welcome and receive.

proposals.reason: Literal mistranslates Xin as trustworthy and repeats the plan; Chinese is the capture.

proposals.before: Welcomes and receives, then Your Majesty can seize him—this is only one strongman's affair."
proposals.after: Xin cried out: "The realm is already at peace; I of course should be boiled alive!"

proposals.reason: Literal belongs to the earlier adoption of the ruse; Chinese is Gaozu silencing Xin.

proposals.before: The emperor went along with it."

proposals.reason: Literal is the capture; Chinese is the assembly at Chen and pacification of Chu.

proposals.before: Xin called: "World already pacified, I surely should be boiled!"
proposals.after: Returning to Luoyang, he pardoned Xin as Marquis of Huaiyin, and divided tallies with meritorious officials to confirm fiefs.
proposals.reason: Literal is Xin's outcry; Chinese is the Luoyang pardon and enfeoffments.

proposals.before: Gaozu looked back and said to Xin: "Do not speak!

proposals.before: And rebel, clear already!"

proposals.before: Thus, met feudal lords at Chen, completely pacified Chu territory.

proposals.reason: Literal is the Chen assembly; Chinese credits Wei Wuzhi for Ping's advancement.

proposals.before: The next year, as Protector of the Army Commandant he followed in attacking the rebel King Han Xin of Dai.
proposals.after: The next year, as Commandant Protector of the Army he followed in attacking the rebel King Han Xin of Han in Dai.
proposals.reason: Literal makes Han Wang Xin King of Dai; Dai is the campaign theater, not his title.

proposals.before: Gaozu returned from breaking Bu's army, wounded by illness, slowly proceeded to Chang'an.
proposals.after: Gaozu returned from breaking Bu's army, ill from his wounds, and slowly proceeded to Chang'an.
proposals.reason: 病創 is a battle wound, not a separate illness.

proposals.before: Using Chen Ping's plan, he summoned the Marquis of Jiang Zhou Bo to receive the command under the bed, saying: "Chen Ping quickly ride the imperial post carriage to carry Bo to replace Kuai as general. When Ping arrives at the army, immediately behead Kuai!"
proposals.after: Using Chen Ping's plan, he summoned the Marquis of Jiang Zhou Bo to receive the command at the bedside, saying: "Chen Ping quickly ride the imperial post carriage to carry Bo to replace Kuai as general. When Ping arrives at the army, immediately behead Kuai!"
proposals.reason: 床下 here is the emperor's bedside, not physically under the bed.

proposals.before: Zhou Bo said: "Fan Kuai because of Empress Lu has closeness;

proposals.reason: The literal English does not translate 未至軍，為壇，以節召樊噲.

proposals.before: Empress Lu is a woman, how can she live long?
proposals.after: Kuai received the edict and was at once bound behind the back, loaded into a prison cart, and relayed to Chang'an; the Marquis of Jiang, Bo, was ordered to take command and lead troops to pacify Yan's rebellious counties.

proposals.before: Ping arrived at the army, beheaded him.
proposals.after: On the way he met a messenger with an edict ordering Ping and Guan Ying to garrison Xingyang.
proposals.reason: The literal English invents an execution and omits 灌嬰 and 滎陽.

proposals.before: Ping constantly produced extraordinary strategies, always beneficial to the state, unwilling to produce dark plots.
proposals.after: Empress Dowager Lu pitied him and said: "You have labored; go out and rest."
proposals.reason: The literal English does not translate 呂太后哀之 and her quoted speech.

proposals.before: Gaozu attacked Qing Bu south, Ping was ill, could not follow, Empress Lu asked: "Chen Ping follows Gaozu in campaigns, constantly resides in the center using extraordinary strategies, finally succeeds.
proposals.after: Ping feared that slander would take hold, so he firmly requested to remain on night-guard duty in the palace.
proposals.reason: The literal English is a different anecdote, not 平畏讒之就，因固請得宿衛中.

proposals.before: Ping said: "Zhou Bo is a blunt and strong man, can be made grand command.

proposals.before: Empress Lu asked: "Who can replace Chen Ping?"
proposals.after: When Fan Kuai arrived, he was pardoned and had his rank and fief restored.
proposals.reason: The literal English does not translate 樊噲至，則赦復爵邑.

proposals.before: Ping said: "Wang Ling can, but Ling is somewhat blunt, Chen Ping can assist him.
proposals.after: In the sixth year of Emperor Xiaohui, Chancellor Cao Shen died; Wang Ling, Marquis of Anguo, was made Right Chancellor, and Chen Ping Left Chancellor.

proposals.before: But Ping from Chu defection, Ling always treated him well.

proposals.reason: The literal English does not translate Ling's Pei origin or Gaozu treating him as an elder brother.

proposals.before: But Ling's wife has wisdom, Ling cannot go against his wife's words.
proposals.after: Ling had little refinement, was given to temperament, and loved blunt speech.
proposals.reason: The literal English invents Ling's wife; the Chinese describes Ling's own character.

proposals.before: Empress Lu asked: "Ling's wife has wisdom, what is it?"
proposals.after: When Gaozu rose at Pei and entered Xianyang, Ling also gathered several thousand followers and stayed in Nanyang, refusing to follow the Lord of Pei.
proposals.reason: The literal English is unrelated to the Nanyang gathering.

proposals.before: Ping said: "Ling's mother is the same mother as Lu Xu, the various Lu wish to make kings, Ling's mother always says it is inappropriate.
proposals.after: Only when the King of Han returned to attack Xiang Ji did Ling attach his troops to Han.
proposals.reason: The literal English invents kinship with Lu Xu and does not translate joining Han against Xiang Ji.

proposals.before: Ling's mother has wisdom.
proposals.after: After Ling's mother had privately seen the envoy off, she wept and said: "For this old woman, tell Ling to serve the King of Han carefully."
proposals.reason: The literal English drops the farewell speech.

proposals.before: Asked: "Cao Shen what kind of person?"
proposals.after: I will see the envoy off with my death.
proposals.reason: The literal English does not translate 妾以死送使者.

proposals.before: Ping said: "Cao Shen has wild strategy, governs the realm, comforts the people, none surpass Shen."
proposals.after: She then fell on a sword and died.
proposals.reason: The literal English does not translate 遂伏劍而死.

proposals.before: Ping said: "Cao Shen has wild strategy, governs the realm, comforts the people, none surpass Shen."
proposals.after: The King of Xiang was furious and boiled Ling's mother.
proposals.reason: The literal English does not translate 項王怒，烹陵母.

proposals.before: Asked: "Chen Ping what kind?"
proposals.after: Ling finally followed the King of Han and helped settle the realm.
proposals.reason: The literal English does not translate 陵卒從漢王定天下.

proposals.before: Said: "Chen Ping has surplus intelligence, but difficult to use alone."
proposals.after: Because he was on good terms with Yong Chi, Gaozu's enemy, and because Ling had originally had no intention of following Gaozu, he was enfeoffed late, as Marquis of Anguo.
proposals.reason: The literal English omits Yong Chi, the late enfeoffment, and the Anguo title.

proposals.before: Asked: "Wang Ling what kind?"
proposals.after: After the Marquis of Anguo had been Right Chancellor for two years, Emperor Xiaohui died.
proposals.reason: The literal English does not translate the two-year tenure or Xiaohui's death.

proposals.before: Said: "Wang Ling is somewhat blunt, can be made general, but cannot lead troops alone."
proposals.after: Empress Dowager Gao wished to make the various Lus kings. She asked Wang Ling, and Wang Ling said: "It must not be done."
proposals.reason: The literal English replaces the refusal of Lu kingships with an unrelated character sketch.

proposals.before: When Ling resigned as prime minister, Empress Lu then moved Ping to be right prime minister, making Marquis of Piyang Shen Yiji left prime minister.
proposals.after: When Ling was dismissed as prime minister, Empress Lu then moved Ping to be right prime minister, making Marquis of Piyang Shen Yiji left prime minister.
proposals.reason: Chinese 免丞相 means dismissal from the chancellorship, not voluntary resignation.

proposals.before: Lu Xu often slandered before, saying Chen Ping had advised Gaozu to execute Fan Kuai, frequently slandered saying: "Chen Ping as prime minister does not handle affairs, daily drinks strong wine, plays with women."
proposals.after: Lu Xu, because Chen Ping had formerly advised Gaozu to seize Fan Kuai, repeatedly slandered him, saying: "Chen Ping as prime minister does not handle affairs, daily drinks strong wine, and sports with women."
proposals.reason: 謀執 is a plan to arrest or seize, not execute; 常以前…數讒 marks a grudge-based repeated slander.

proposals.before: Ping apologized saying: "Master servant!
proposals.after: Ping apologized, saying: "I am overwhelmed!
proposals.reason: 主臣 is a stock humble exclamation of alarm before the throne, not the words Master servant.

proposals.before: Year 2 died, son Marquis Jian Hou Ji inherited the marquisate.
proposals.after: In the second year he died, and his son Hui, Marquis Jian, inherited the marquisate.
proposals.reason: The heir's given name is 恢 (Hui), not Ji; 簡侯 is the marquis title.

proposals.before: Year 23 He committed the crime of raping his subordinate's wife, beheaded, fief abolished.
proposals.after: In the twenty-third year He was convicted of abducting another man's wife, executed in the marketplace, and the fief was abolished.
proposals.reason: 略人妻 is abducting a person's wife, not a subordinate; 棄市 is marketplace execution, not necessarily beheading.

proposals.before: When he was cutting meat on the butcher's block, his ambitions were already far-reaching.
proposals.after: When he was cutting meat on the sacrificial board, his ambitions were already far-reaching.
proposals.reason: 俎 here is the sacrificial cutting board at the village altar, not a commercial butcher's block; the literal rendering invents a butcher shop setting.

decisions.reason: 好美如陳平 names Chen Ping's fine looks; the original's 'fond of beauty and as handsome' is a double reading the Chinese does not support. The rhetorical 人固有…者乎 is correctly recast as 'has there ever been'.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 高帝從破布軍還，病創

decisions.reason: 受詔床下, with the emperor ill, is receipt of the edict at the bedside, not physically under the bed.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 召絳侯周勃受詔床下

decisions.reason: The original English is unrelated dialogue. Before reaching the army they built an altar and summoned Fan Kuai with the tally (節).

sourceWitness.excerpt: 未至軍，為壇，以節召樊噲

decisions.reason: The original English is an unrelated remark about Empress Lu. Kuai is bound, loaded in a prison cart, and sent to Chang'an, while the Marquis of Jiang, Bo, takes command to pacify Yan's rebel counties.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 噲受詔，即反接載檻車，傳詣長安，而令絳侯勃代將，將兵定燕反縣

decisions.reason: The original invents Ping beheading Kuai. A messenger edict orders Ping and Guan Ying to garrison Xingyang; there is no execution here.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 逢使者詔平與灌嬰屯於滎陽

decisions.after: Empress Dowager Lu was moved by his grief and said: "You have labored; go out and rest."
decisions.reason: The original does not translate this unit. 呂太后哀之 after Ping's weeping is being moved by his grief, not merely pity; her speech tells him he has labored and should go out to rest.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 呂太后哀之，曰：「君勞，出休矣。」

decisions.reason: The original is a different Qing Bu anecdote. Ping feared slander would take hold and insisted on remaining in palace night-guard duty.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 平畏讒之就，因固請得宿衛中

decisions.reason: The original is unrelated advice about Zhou Bo. Thereafter Lu Xu's slanders could not take effect.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 是後呂媭讒乃不得行

decisions.reason: The original invents Empress Lu asking who can replace Ping. When Fan Kuai arrived he was pardoned and had rank and fief restored.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 樊噲至，則赦復爵邑

decisions.reason: The original is invented dialogue. In Xiaohui's sixth year Chancellor Cao Shen died; Wang Ling, Marquis of Anguo, became Right Chancellor and Chen Ping Left Chancellor.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 孝惠帝六年，相國曹參卒，以安國侯王陵為右丞相，陳平為左丞相

decisions.reason: The original does not translate this unit. Wang Ling was a man of Pei and a county strongman; when Gaozu was still obscure he treated Ling as an elder brother.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 王陵者，故沛人，始為縣豪，高祖微時，兄事陵

decisions.reason: The original invents Ling's wife. The Chinese describes Ling himself: little refinement, given to temperament, fond of blunt speech.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 陵少文，任氣，好直言

decisions.reason: The original is unrelated dialogue. When Gaozu rose at Pei and entered Xianyang, Ling gathered several thousand followers, stayed in Nanyang, and refused to follow the Lord of Pei.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 及高祖起沛，入至咸陽，陵亦自聚黨數千人，居南陽，不肯從沛公

decisions.reason: The original invents shared maternity with Lu Xu. Only when the King of Han returned to attack Xiang Ji did Ling attach his troops to Han.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 及漢王之還攻項籍，陵乃以兵屬漢

decisions.reason: The original drops the farewell. After privately seeing the envoy off, Ling's mother weeps and tells him to serve the King of Han carefully.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 陵母既私送使者，泣曰：「為老妾語陵，謹事漢王

decisions.reason: The original asks about Cao Shen. Ling's mother says she will see the envoy off with her death.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 妾以死送使者

decisions.reason: The original is invented Cao Shen praise. She then fell on a sword and died.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 遂伏劍而死

decisions.reason: The original repeats the Cao Shen line. The King of Xiang, enraged, boiled Ling's mother.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 項王怒，烹陵母

decisions.reason: The original asks what kind of person Chen Ping is. Ling finally followed the King of Han and helped settle the realm.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 陵卒從漢王定天下

decisions.reason: The original omits Yong Chi and the late Anguo enfeoffment. Ling was enfeoffed late as Marquis of Anguo because he was close to Yong Chi, Gaozu's enemy, and had not meant to follow Gaozu.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 以善雍齒，雍齒，高帝之仇，而陵本無意從高帝，以故晚封，為安國侯

decisions.reason: The original asks what kind of person Wang Ling is. After two years as Right Chancellor, Emperor Xiaohui died.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 安國侯既為右丞相，二歲，孝惠帝崩

decisions.reason: The original replaces the episode with a character sketch. Empress Dowager Gao wished to make the Lü kings; Wang Ling said it must not be done.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 高后欲立諸呂為王，問王陵，王陵曰：「不可。」

decisions.reason: 陵之免丞相 is removal from the chancellorship (免), not a voluntary 'resignation' as the original has it; the following transfers follow that dismissal.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 陵之免丞相

decisions.reason: 謀執樊噲 is a plan to seize/arrest Fan Kuai, not to execute him. 常以前…數讒 marks repeated slander from that earlier grudge.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 呂媭常以前陳平為高帝謀執樊噲，數讒曰

decisions.reason: 主臣 is a stock exclamation of alarm and humility before the throne, not the words 'Master servant'.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 平謝曰：「主臣！

decisions.reason: The heir's given name is 恢 (Hui), not Ji; 簡侯 is the marquis title Marquis Jian, which the original garbles as 'Marquis Jian Hou Ji'.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 子簡侯恢代侯

decisions.reason: 略人妻 is abducting another person's wife, not raping a subordinate's wife; 棄市 is marketplace execution, not specifically beheading.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 何坐略人妻，棄市，國除

decisions.reason: 俎 here is the sacrificial cutting board of the village-altar meat division, not a commercial butcher's block.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 方其割肉俎上之時
